en: Not enough gold. Dida does not do credit. Dida has met adventurers.
Click gear to take it off, tick up to four abilities, use what you carry.
Four abilities at most. The fifth one would not fit in your head.
Click to put it back in the pack.
Everything priced in twelves. It is a sacred number, and also good for business.
Point at something to read about it. Selling pays half.
Sold out. Come back after the next saucer crash.
%d of %d pages recovered. Mirg is keeping count too, angrily.
Esc to go back. Found pages can be read; missing ones are still out there.
No comment. The medium needed a rest.
An undying god who lives under a mountain. We would have hired him, but he refused to be fifteen metres tall.
Caps for nobles, hair for everyone else. We had castes too, but ours were measured with a ladder.
A king who banned wine and was still popular. Among the Lobizi he would have been made a sage. A very thirsty one.
A calendar made of stone. Ours was made of seventy sages, which is why every year was a little late.
KOSON. Very shiny. I would like it noted that we never stole any of it. We stole the records of it, which is different.
A wolf head that howls in the wind. Our engineers saw it and went very quiet. Then they built the saucer whistle.
A legion lost its eagle. We lost a parcel for 188 hours. I feel this is the same level of embarrassment.
Rome paying Dacia. History we went to a lot of trouble to erase. Someone keep an eye on the treasurer.
Decebalus took in deserters. We took in nobody. That is why our parties were so quiet.
A bridge across the Danube. Impressive, for people who cannot simply step over it.
A whole river moved to hide some gold. We moved a mountain once to hide a sandwich. Nobody wrote that down.
A whole war, carved round and round a column. Mirg tried that with your fate. He ran out of column.
No quests yet. Talk to people. They love giving strangers chores.
Three copies of your fate, kept outside Mirg's book. The autosave keeps a fourth, quietly.
Damaged. Water, fire or a strigoi got to it. It cannot be read.
Written by a newer version of the game. It cannot be read here.
The save could not be written.
Twelve pages, and Mirg's book of fates has a hole in it shaped exactly like you.
%d pages of the Dacian Scrolls recovered.
You did it alone. Fanfi does not count as company.
Never abducted. The saucers will be filing a complaint.
Abducted once. The medical results are confidential.
Abducted %d times. At this point you have a loyalty card.
Boier Duras was talked into paying. A strigoi who respects paperwork.
Boier Duras was persuaded with a falx. The treasury does not ask how.
Ozo the thrall walked away free. He has never been this confused.
Ozo the thrall was beaten. The parcel did not care either way.
Ozo the thrall was talked or paid out of the way.
A strigoi owes you a favour. Try not to collect it at night.
Fanfi: It was adequate. Final communication of the evening. The medium wants to go home, and so, I suspect, do you. Fanfi, signing off.
